title: hla-wgs: HLA typing from whole-genome sequencing with a per-allele statement of what is certain
description: Single Rust program that types 18 HLA genes (A, B, C, DRB1, DRB3, DRB4, DRB5, DQA1, DQB1, DPA1, DPB1, DRA, E, F, G, H, K, V) from short-read whole-genome sequencing (FASTQ, BAM or CRAM). For every allele it reports the best four-field name, the resolution up to which the call is certain, copy number for DRB3/4/5, H and K, and positions at which the reads differ from the named allele (candidate new alleles). The reference database is built locally from the IPD-IMGT/HLA release with hla-wgs build-db; no IPD-IMGT/HLA sequences are distributed. Validated against haplotype-resolved HPRC assemblies, GIAB trios and 1000 Genomes laboratory typing. Research use only.
